store.name: OgaBassey Official Store
store.social_note: DMs on Instagram are monitored but response is faster via WhatsApp or phone.

shipping.fee_note: Shipping is not free. Delivery fee is calculated at checkout based on destination.
shipping.total_estimate: 1 to 9 business days from order to delivery
shipping.note: Timing depends on stock status, payment confirmation, destination city, and courier availability. Inspect the package at delivery before accepting it for high-value orders.

warranty.new_devices: Manufacturer warranty applies. Term and coverage depend on manufacturer and model.
warranty.used_and_open_box_devices: 1 year OgaBassey store warranty on eligible pre-owned and open-box devices.
warranty.covered_faults: Device stops turning on, camera stops working, and other electronic defects not caused by user.
warranty.exclusions: Screen damage, physical damage, liquid damage, and power surge damage are excluded.
warranty.assurance_product: OgaBassey Assurance adds screen and liquid damage protection for up to 1 year. Available at checkout for eligible devices.
warranty.how_to_claim: Contact support via WhatsApp or phone to start a warranty claim. Have your order number ready.

returns.policy: Report an undisclosed technical defect within 14 days of delivery.
returns.remedy: OgaBassey will complete a repair or replacement within the 14-day period for eligible faults.
returns.exclusions: Physical damage, liquid damage, and power surge damage are excluded.
returns.pre_return_step: Contact support before sending anything back so they can confirm the return process.

return_shipping.approved_fault: OgaBassey pays return shipping for approved fault returns.
return_shipping.change_of_mind: Customer pays return shipping for change-of-mind buybacks.

returns.buyback: If you change your mind and the device has no fault, ask support about a buyback. Buyback price is the original device value minus 15 to 20 percent.
returns.consumer_rights: Your rights under Nigerian consumer law still apply.

how_it_works: 1. Take photos or a short 10-second video showing device screen and body.
2. AI grades your device condition automatically.
3. Accept the offer and swap instantly — or visit the store for a physical inspection.
swap.final_offer_factors: Model, storage size, screen condition, battery health, camera condition, accessories, repair history, and whether the device powers on normally.
preparation_checklist: Back up your data before submission.
Remove your personal accounts where possible (iCloud, Google account, Samsung account).
Keep the charger, receipt, or box available if you have them.
swap.note: The bot collects your device details and shows the catalog price of your desired upgrade. The final trade-in credit is confirmed by the sales team after physical inspection. Visit the store or a rep will follow up with you.

payments.accepted_methods: Card payments via Paystack checkout on ogabassey.com
payments.installment_note: Contact support to ask about installment or payment plan options. Not available for all products.

imei_check.description: Check if a device is blacklisted, carrier-locked, or has an active iCloud/Google lock before buying.

repairs.description: OgaBassey offers device repair services. Contact support or visit the store to book a repair.

quick_replies.price_check: Send the device name (e.g. iPhone 16 Pro) and we will send you the current price.
quick_replies.swap: Type *swap* to start the trade-in process.
quick_replies.store: 📍 2 Olaide Tomori Street, Ikeja, Lagos. Open Mon–Sat 9am–6pm. Call +2348146978921.
quick_replies.track_order: Visit https://ogabassey.com/track-order and enter your order number.
